definition: LTX Studio is an artificial intelligence (AI) video-generation platform launched in February 2024 by Israeli tech company Lightricks.
details: LTX Studio is part of the LTX ecosystem, developed by Lightricks, that includes an open-source model (LTX-2) and commercial API access. The product lets users turn text prompts or scripts into characters, scenes, storyboards, and video sequences with integrated editing controls such as framing and camera direction. LTX Studio entered public availability later in 2024 after a beta period.

explainer.lead: LTX Studio is an AI video-generation platform launched in February 2024 by Lightricks. It matters because it turns text prompts or scripts into editable characters, scenes, storyboards and video.

tiers.eli5: You type a story or idea and it builds the characters, scenes and video shots for you, with controls to adjust the camera.
tiers.practitioner: Used to go from script to storyboard and video with integrated editing controls such as framing and camera direction; it entered public availability later in 2024 after a beta.
tiers.paperLevel: A commercial product within the LTX ecosystem, which also includes an open-source model (LTX-2) and commercial API access; it is not itself a formal model definition.

explainer.example: A creator enters a short script and LTX Studio generates characters, a storyboard and video sequences with adjustable framing.
